title: Core 14-Woman #05
prompt:
Image format: a landscape-orientation photograph, 16:9 aspect ratio, significantly wider than it is tall, fourteen women in a single row.

A photograph of FOURTEEN women standing side by side in a single row at the same ground level on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, each woman in her own distinct pose, generous horizontal spacing between each so every figure reads clearly and large within the frame, all real photographic skin with visible pores, no illustration finish, no CG sheen, all faces, hands and feet in correct proportion. The camera set back so all 14 fit comfortably within the wide frame from head to toe, 50mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking across all of them from one side, sharp focus head to toe on each — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render. Exactly 14 women, no more, no fewer.

Left to right:
[jirai-kei / Glamour Hourglass]: Japanese woman, early 30s, demure and soft, pale porcelain skin, pink-red eyeshadow smudged softly beneath both eyes, a delicate tear-track blush across the cheeks, large dark circle lenses with bright real catchlights, long lashes, glossy pink-red lips, a hollow, dreamy expression, soft pastel-peach hair styled in a short pixie cut, almond nails (glossy). a stunning hourglass figure, full rounded bust, dramatically narrow cinched waist, wide curvaceous hips. Correct proportion in hands/feet. Painted in Vasarely-inspired optical-illusion pattern (a repeating grid of squares bulging in a 3D illusion), covering her whole body below the jaw with no bare skin, face unpainted. Piercings: no piercings. Jewellery: a single piece of rose-gold earrings. Pose: back three-quarters to camera, head turned back. Shoes: extreme silver platform stiletto Mary Janes.

Piercings: 200pc drop dangles/diamonds/rose-gold/sym. Jewellery: two to three pieces of platinum a necklace. Pose: kneeling on both knees, facing camera.
